A shape the world started, and then forgot to finish. It is trying to finish itself out of you.
Noonless Seraph
Light, before anyone decided what light was for.
Primordial Ooze
Everything was this, once. It would like everything to be this again. It is patient.
Sketch of a Beast
Four legs, roughly. A head, approximately. The idea of an animal, charging.
Firstborn Hound
The first animal the sun ever shone on. Every hound since is a copy of a copy of it.
Edge Knight
Where the light ended and the dark began, someone had to stand guard. This is the line, wearing armor.
The Unblinking
The first thing that ever saw anything. It has not looked away since.
First Tree
Before forests, there was one tree. It was very lonely. It has not forgiven anyone for the others.
Wishing Mote
Somebody's wish, still looking for them. Swords pass right through it. Spells do not.
Hoarder Mimic
It ate a treasure chest, then everything the chest's owner ever lost. It is mostly stomach now.
The Unremembered Knight
Every soldier nobody remembers ends up here. Together, they make one knight. It has a great many names and can say none of them.
The Rime Sovereign
Queen of the first winter. She ruled a kingdom of snow with no one in it, and she ruled it very well.
What everything was before the sun gave it edges. Not evil. Not anything. It would like you to be nothing too, very gently.
Shard of Before
A piece of the First Dark that broke off to look at you more closely.
Lysa's Echo
Lysa Lorne, ten years old, hiding since the night of the festival. Nobody ever found her. She is very, very good at this game.
Festival Lantern
A paper lantern from the summer festival, forty years ago. Still lit. Still warm.
The Drowned Hound, Remembered
The first monster you ever fought, the way you remember it: bigger.
Remembered Pup
Even the pups came back bigger.
Every sailor who survived the strait told the story again. Each time, the serpent grew a little.
Red Tam, Legend (Self-Proclaimed)
Red Tam as Red Tam tells it: eight feet tall, undefeated, beloved by all. The Gloam took him at his word.
Tall-Tale Bandit
Tam says there were forty of them. There were four. These are the forty.
Sister Mercy, as Remembered
Her hymns, her certainty, her gentle voice. The Gloam remembered all of it and none of the doubt.
Gloam Beast, Remembered
It used to be a person. In the memory, it still is, a little.
Glasswyrm Echo
A sand wyrm of the Sunscar, remembered by everyone who ever heard the dunes hum.
Glass Scorpion
Clear as a window. You can see what it ate.
The Penitent, Remembered
The black knight, the hollow mask. The Gloam remembers the armor. It does not remember who was inside.
Garrick Thorne, Remembered
The Lord-Commander, exactly as hard as you remember. Possibly harder. Memory is not a fair judge.
Dawnguard Echo
A soldier who followed orders. The Gloam kept the orders and lost the soldier.
Echo of the Blind Choir
A Remnant's hymn, sung back by the dark. Every note correct. None of them meant.
Echo of the Mire Mother
The swamp's mother, remembered as she was at the end: sick, and still feeding everyone.
Echo of the Storm Herald
Lightning remembers where it struck. It would like to strike there again.
The Noon King, Remembered
